categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Lyric Robot Automation Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end intelligent manufacturing equipment. Its main business segments include equipment for new energy sectors such as power lithium batteries, 3C lithium batteries, solid-state batteries, energy storage, perovskite, hydrogen energy, as well as smart logistics, ICT, AI computing power, and automotive parts. The company provides digital intelligent factory solutions covering the entire production chain from specialized machines to full production lines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies including intelligent sensing, control, execution, digitalization, intelligent warehousing, laser application, and vacuum technologies. It develops advanced manufacturing equipment such as dual-layer wide coating machines, laser cutting and slitting machines, high-speed winding machines, and integrated formation and capacity testing machines. The company also emphasizes R&D in solid-state battery equipment, laser welding, digital twin technology, and flexible assembly, leveraging proprietary algorithms and AI for process optimization and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in the new energy industry including lithium battery manufacturers, automotive companies, and electronics firms. Notable clients include ATL, CATL, BYD, Guoxuan High-Tech, Sunwoda, GAC, Envision Power, and international companies like Samsung SDI, LG Energy Solution, and SK On. The company also serves markets in smart logistics, AI computing, and automotive parts manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and multiple production bases in Huizhou, Ningde, Nantong, and other cities. It has expanded globally with subsidiaries and offices in Germany, Poland, Switzerland, the UK, the USA, Canada, South Korea, Japan, and Hungary. The company has established localized R&D, production, sales, and after-sales service capabilities to support global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lyric Robot Automation operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying high-end intelligent manufacturing equipment and integrated production lines to battery manufacturers and related industries. It also provides value-added services such as digital factory solutions and smart logistics systems, positioning itself as a key equipment supplier and solution provider within the new energy and semiconductor equipment ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven innovation with significant investment in R&D, focusing on high-precision, high-stability, and cost-effective equipment. Strategic R&D directions include solid-state battery manufacturing equipment, laser processing technologies, digital twin platforms, AI-enabled intelligent manufacturing, and flexible assembly systems. It aims to deepen cooperation with leading customers, expand into emerging sectors like AI computing and perovskite solar cells, and enhance global market penetration while maintaining over 10% of revenue invested in R&D.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized high-end intelligent manufacturing equipment and integrated production lines. The company also earns income from providing value-added services such as equipment upgrades, digital factory solutions, and after-sales support. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, with contract-based pricing including milestone payments tied to delivery, acceptance, and warranty periods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lyric Robot Automation is recognized as a leading global player in the lithium battery manufacturing equipment industry. It competes with other top-tier equipment manufacturers serving the new energy sector, including international and domestic firms. The company leverages its strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product portfolio, and strategic partnerships with industry leaders to maintain a competitive edge and expand its market share in emerging technologies like solid-state batteries and AI-enabled manufacturing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 2.48 billion, a 50.3% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to industry slowdown and strategic order contraction. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.04 billion. Total assets stood at RMB 8.79 billion with a slight decrease from the prior year. Despite financial pressures, the company improved operating cash flow to positive territory and continues to invest heavily in R&D, representing 13.55% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lyric Robot Automation emphasizes its technological leadership, comprehensive product coverage across the entire lithium battery manufacturing process, and integrated digital intelligent factory solutions. Its products feature advanced automation, high precision, and flexible customization capabilities, supported by proprietary core technologies and extensive patent portfolios. The company’s global footprint and strong customer relationships enable it to deliver high-quality, efficient, and scalable manufacturing solutions tailored to evolving industry demands.
